messages:
sanjay: Hi team — SOC2 fieldwork update from auditor_jane. They want a short staged playback showing RBAC change provenance + KMS key wrap/unwrap during a simulated incident. Can we assemble a minimal evidence set?
lee: +1. Do they want live access or packaged artifacts?
auditor_jane: Packaged artifacts preferred, but we need the ability to verify timeline and key usage. Looking for: 1) exact RBAC change diff, 2) KMS envelope usage logs for any decrypts, 3) any incident correlation (if the change touched a service account).
ada: We can produce a playback tar with: terraform plan diff, github pr link, k8s RoleBinding patch, controller audit logs, and KMS CloudTrail snippets. Is that sufficient?
auditor_jane: That should work. Also need to ensure logs show request IDs and principal identity (OIDC/email).
sanjay: I'll coordinate. Plan: create a small staging runbook that replays the RBAC change in a read-only way and captures system traces. We will NOT rotate keys during replay. We'll include CloudTrail entries and KMS decrypt events.
lee: Note: our KMS is using envelope encryption via keyring 'projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/llm-wrap'. For staging playback we will use the staging keyring. I'll add a mapping file that ties staging->prod names in the manifest.
auditor_jane: We need assurance that the staging entries are representative. Provide a short mapping doc that explains differences and a hash of exported artifacts.
ada: Quick Q: for RBAC diff, do you accept a `git diff` of the terraform and the `kubectl patch` commands as evidence, or do you need an applied state snapshot (k8s API response)?
auditor_jane: Both if easy. Applied state (kubectl get rolebinding -o yaml with metadata.managedFields) is best. `git diff` is fine as supplemental.
sanjay: On incident linkage — if the change was part of a vuln triage, we must attach the vuln ticket number and any Slack bridgecall logs. We have an internal ticket RIF-4321 where this was discussed. I'll include a sanitized excerpt.
lee: Commands I'll run to capture evidence (will include in README):
```
# dump k8s rolebinding after change
kubectl get rolebinding app-read-access -n infra -o yaml > evidence/rolebinding-app-read.yaml

# export controller audit log lines (filter by principals and timeframe)
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_cluster" AND protoPayload.authentication.principalEmail="ops@redwood.ai"' --start-time="2025-02-18T10:00:00Z" --end-time="2025-02-18T10:10:00Z" > evidence/controller-audit.json

# extract KMS decrypt events from CloudTrail/CloudLogs
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="cloudkms.projects.locations.keyRings.cryptoKeys.decrypt"' --limit=100 > evidence/kms-decrypts.json
```
ada: I'll produce a small script to canonicalize timestamps and redact irrelevant IPs, and then compute a sha256 manifest for the tarball.
auditor_jane: Great. One more ask: can you include a signed statement from the oncall who executed the replay (or a generated GPG-signed checksum)? We need non-repudiation.
sanjay: oncall-bot can post an execution confirmation but for a signature we can include a GPG-signed file from the operator. I'll arrange that.
lee: Also, to prove envelope usage, I'll include the KMS key version in the decrypt logs and a sample base64 cipherblob with its keyId header (sanitized). Eg: `{\"ciphertext\":\"...\",\"keyId\":\"projects/.../cryptoKeyVersions/3\"}`
auditor_jane: Perfect. Lastly, timeframe constraints: auditor will accept artifacts referencing a 7-day window. Keep playback within that.
nada: Timeline: I'll assemble the tar + README + sha256 + gpg.sig by EOD tomorrow. Sanjay will run the staging playback and oncall-bot will post confirmation.
sanjay: I'll also attach the Slack bridgecall snippet (sanitized) and note any related vuln triage actions. If we hit any PII in logs I'll scrub and note methodology.
auditor_jane: Thanks — please DM me the S3 presigned link when ready.
oncall-bot: Playback runbook executed by sanjay at 2025-02-18T10:05:23Z — evidence bundle created: s3://redwood-audit-temp/6888888000-playback.tar.gz (presigned link expired in 1h). :white_check_mark:
lee: tagging the evidence manifest here: SHA256: 3b7f8c9d2a... (included in tar).
ada: Filing follow-up checklist for SOC2 team: 1) include mapping doc, 2) include KMS key/version pointers, 3) signed checksum, 4) applied-state snapshots, 5) Slack bridgecall extract.
auditor_jane: Looks good. I'll review the package once I get the presigned link. Thank you for the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:
